news.contents: T.J. Hockenson caught 6-of-7 targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.analysis: After missing a week due to a wrist injury, Hockenson was back in action Sunday night. The veteran TE finished with his second-highest reception total of the season, gaining over 50 yards for just the third time on the campaign. This was Hockenson's first game back with veteran QB Kirk Cousins leading the Minnesota offense. Hockenson could be set for a productive stretch run.
news.title: T.J. Hockenson hauls in six passes Sunday night

news.contents: Week 12 is Thanksgiving Week in the NFL, and fantasy football managers are thankful because this means no teams are on bye.This also means the fantasy waiver wire is littered with more options than usual since everyone is playing except the injured guys. The need to pick up a tight end this week is less than normal since no team is off, except if your roster has less talent at tight end on it than the cast of a low-budget slasher flick.Here are the top waiver wire picks and streamers at the ...
news.title: Tight Ends Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Pickups - Week 12 TE Options Include T.J. Hockenson, Chig Okonkwo, Kyle Pitts Sr., Mike Gesicki, more

news.contents: Ravens DE Trey Hendrickson (knee) is questionable to return Sunday.
news.analysis: Hendrickson's absence will leave the Ravens short a pass rusher in what has been a high scoring affair against the Panthers. Hendrickson had tallied one quarterback hit and one pass defensed prior to exiting with the injury.
news.title: Trey Hendrickson (knee) questionable to return

news.contents: Troy Franklin failed to catch either of his two targets in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
news.analysis: Franklin had three receptions for 31 yards in Week 9 before being held without a catch Sunday. Meanwhile, Jaylen Waddle, Evan Engram and Pat Bryant combined for 167 of Bo Nix's 225 passing yards. Franklin is expendable in most redraft leagues.
news.title: Troy Franklin held without a catch in Week 11

trades.description: 1 Pick for Davis, Miller and 1 Pick

news.contents: Kimani Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.analysis: Vidal was productive in the close loss, averaging 5.1 yards per carry behind starter Omarion Hampton. Vidal could be in line for a larger role moving forward as Keaton Mitchell missed time in Week 11 with back and knee issues. The Chargers will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.
news.title: Kimani Vidal rolls up 54 all-purpose yards in Week 11

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Kimani Vidal took a backseat in the Chargers' Week 10 victory over the Baltimore Ravens. Vidal finished with two carries for zero yards as Omarion Hampton stole the show on Monday Night Football. The 25-year-old was uninvolved in the offense and saw his lowest snap percentage since Week 3. With Hampton's emergence, Vidal's fantasy value slides back to a handcuff running back at best. Vidal enters Week 11 as RotoBaller's PPR RB40 in a plus matchup against the ...
news.title: Kimani Vidal Off Fantasy Radars in Week 11 vs. Jets

news.contents: Aaron Rodgers went 30/44 for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He added five rushes for 29 yards.
news.analysis: The almost 43-year-old Rodgers becomes the second-oldest player in NFL history to lead his team in rush yards, only trailing Tom Brady. After a four-game stretch of 11 passing touchdowns, Rodgers has now totaled four in his last four games. Rodgers faces a tough Denver defense on Sunday, where he holds no more than QB2 value.
news.title: Aaron Rodgers leads Steelers in rush yards in Week 11's loss

news.contents: Saints TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring) is questionable to return against Chicago.
news.analysis: Johnson had not recorded a reception on just one target prior to exiting the game. Noah Fant should see an uptick in playing time for the remainder of the game if Johnson cannot return.
news.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) questionable to return

news.contents: New Orleans Saints tight end Juwan Johnson (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears after being injured in the third quarter. Johnson didn't have a stat line at the time of his exit, having failed to catch his only target of the game up to that point. Wide receiver Chris Olave led the Saints' receiving room with five catches on 10 targets for 63 yards at the time of Johnson's exit. news.title: Juwan Johnson Questionable to Return with Hamstring Injury

news.analysis: Washington led Miami pass catchers in receptions on the day. He remains a borderline WR3/flex play in deeper leagues moving forward.

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals kicker Evan McPherson's streak of perfection came to an end in last week's 38-18 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers. McPherson missed his first kick of the season on a 43-yard field goal attempt in the second quarter of Week 10. Despite the missed field goal, the Bengals kicker was perfect on all five of his extra-point attempts in the contest. McPherson will look to begin a new streak of made field goals as the team travels to Washington to face the Commanders. This ...
